κυρβᾰσία , ἡ,
A.Persian bonnet or hat, with a peaked crown, prob. much like the τιάρα (q.v.), Hdt. 5.49 , 7.64 ; ὥσπερ βασιλεὺς ὁ μέγας διαβάσκει ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς τὴν κ. τῶν ὀρνίθων μόνος ὀρθήν (sc. ὁ ἀλεκτρυών) Ar. Av. 487 (cf. Sch.); a cover for a poultice for a woman's breast is compared to it in shape, Hp. Mul. 2.186 , cf. Aret. CA 1.10 .
II. = Lat. apex (of the flamines), D.H. 2.70 .
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
